---
name: Removal request
about: Ask for a camera, stream or other material to be removed from this page
title: 'Removal request: '
labels: takedown
---

Thank you for getting in touch. Material named here will be taken off the page promptly, usually within a day of this issue being seen.

**What should be removed?**
Name the view as it appears on the page (for example "Rotterdam · Amazonehaven west"), or paste the link to the original stream or image.

**Your connection to it**
For example: you operate the camera, you own the channel, or you act for the rights holder.

**Anything else we should know**

Please do not include private contact details here; this issue is public. If you need a private reply, say so and a way to reach you will be arranged.
